purpose: Create a deterministic, result-blind rider identity mapping layer from retrospective PRE race-card names to official KEIRIN.JP registration numbers before rider-level affinity research.

input.historical_pre_identity: rider_name_raw from bound retrospective PRE parser
input.official_identity_source: KEIRIN.JP rider search/profile keyed by registration number

normalization_v1: collapse internal ASCII/full-width whitespace to one separator
preserve kanji characters exactly after NFKC
do not phonetic-guess or manually substitute characters
candidate_resolution_order: if exactly one active/current official profile exact normalized full-name match exists, record as CANDIDATE_MATCH not final historical truth
verify historical PRE prefecture/class only if those fields are present in the same PRE artifact and comparison semantics are valid
if more than one candidate, zero candidates, contradictory evidence, or suspected renamed rider: FAIL_CLOSED
important_current_profile_limit: Current active/profile status cannot prove historical participation by itself. Registration-number mapping is accepted only when the historical PRE identity and official identity evidence are non-ambiguous under the frozen rules; time-varying profile fields are never backfilled as historical features.
population_lock_rule: The complete mapping table for a proposed fit/evaluation population must be generated from PRE-only identities and frozen by content hash before any target RESULT is opened.
missingness_rule: Unmapped rider causes the race to fail closed for rider-specific affinity models; do not encode unmapped identity as zero, average rider, venue-only substitute, or anonymous reusable bucket unless separately prespecified before RESULT.
